item.title: Good Morning Family - 16 July 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Thursday, the 16 July.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 8 degrees and a top of 15 degrees.
There is about a 4 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is O.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter O?
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
